text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: PICO-8 is a fantasy console created by Lexaloffle Games in 2014. It provides a limited hardware specification designed to recreate the experience of developing and playing games on classic systems. Games are distributed as small cartridge files called carts and can be created using built-in tools for programming, graphics, music, and sound effects. The platform has a large community library of independently created games and has been used for small-scale game development and experimentation.
